title: 土耳其难民在希腊海域被驱逐
desc: 土耳其难民在希腊海域被驱逐

paragraphs.en: Since this past February, VOA has talked to scores of refugees in Turkey who have tried and failed to get into Greece.
paragraphs.zh: 自今年二月以来，美国之音采访了土耳其境内数十名试图进入希腊但失败的难民。

paragraphs.en: Back then, the Turkish government was openly encouraging them to make the trip.
paragraphs.zh: 当时，土耳其政府公开鼓励他们进行偷渡。

paragraphs.en: But the Greek government has told them not to come and many refugees report being beaten, robbed, and then expelled after they arrived.
paragraphs.zh: 但希腊政府已告知他们不要前来，许多难民称，他们抵达后遭到殴打、抢劫，然后被驱逐出境。

paragraphs.en: In recent months, the stories have grown even more harrowing.
paragraphs.zh: 最近几个月，这些故事变得更加令人痛心。

paragraphs.en: Families tell of being abandoned at sea by Greek authorities on rubber boats without motors or fuel.
paragraphs.zh: 一些家庭讲述了他们被希腊当局遗弃在海上的经历，他们乘坐的是没有发动机和燃料的橡皮艇。

paragraphs.en: They dragged our rubber boat to water that seemed to be hidden by mountains and circled around us until we were bailing water out with our own hands. I thought the children would drown.
paragraphs.zh: 他们把我们的橡皮艇拖到了似乎被群山遮挡的水域，橡皮艇在水中打着转，最后我们只能用手往外舀水。我以为孩子们会被淹死。

paragraphs.en: Najma and her family were on their third attempt to reach Greece when their boat was stopped and their fuel was seized by what appeared to be Greek security forces.
paragraphs.zh: 纳吉玛和她的家人第三次试图抵达希腊时，他们的船被疑似希腊安全部队拦截，燃油也被没收了。

paragraphs.en: But they were lucky. A passenger had enough fuel hidden away to get them back to Turkey.
paragraphs.zh: 但他们很幸运。一名乘客藏了足够的燃料，让他们得以返回土耳其。

paragraphs.en: When they caught our boat, I woke up as we were dragged back into Turkish waters.
paragraphs.zh: 当他们追上我们的船时，我们被拖回土耳其海域，我醒了过来。

paragraphs.en: I wasn't scared until I thought they were going to rip open our boat with pikes.
paragraphs.zh: 直到我以为他们会用长矛刺穿我们的船时，我才感到害怕。

paragraphs.en: On a previous trip, they made it to the Greek islands.
paragraphs.zh: 在之前的一次旅行中，他们到达了希腊群岛。

paragraphs.en: But they were soon arrested and left on rafts at sea before they were rescued by the Turkish coast guard.
paragraphs.zh: 但他们很快就被逮捕，被扔在海上的木筏上，之后才被土耳其海岸警卫队救起。

paragraphs.en: The New York Times recently reported Greece has secretly expelled more than 1,000 people in recent months, abandoning many of them at sea outside of Greek territorial waters.
paragraphs.zh: 《纽约时报》最近报道称，希腊近几个月来已秘密驱逐了1000多人，还将其中许多人遗弃在希腊领海之外的海域。

paragraphs.en: But Greece has denied any illegal activity, noting that it has rescued tens of thousands of asylum seekers in recent years.
paragraphs.zh: 但希腊否认有任何非法活动，并指出近年来希腊已经解救了数以万计的寻求庇护者。

paragraphs.en: The government adds it protects European Union borders vigorously with tough but fair policies.
paragraphs.zh: 希腊政府补充说，它通过强硬但公平的政策大力保护欧盟边境。
